newsitem.title: FINLAND: METSA-SERLA PLANS LISTING FOR TISSUE UNIT.
newsitem.headline: METSA-SERLA PLANS LISTING FOR TISSUE UNIT.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said on Wednesday it was considering a separate listing on the Helsinki stock exchange for its tissue paper unit.
Metsa-Serla said it would retain a majority stake in and control over the business operations of a listed tissue unit.
"The company would be Europe's first bourse-listed company primarily making and marketing tissue paper," it said.
In 1996, Metsa-Serla's tissue unit's net sales were 1.84 billion markka or some 12 percent of total group sales.
The unit's 1996 operating profit was 161 million markka (18 percent of group operating profit) and the unit's performance developed favourably in the first quarter of 1997, Metsa-Serla said.
Enskilda Securities will be its advisor on the listing.
